'''Ion Toderaș''' (17 August 1948 – 4 May 2026) was a Moldovan ecologist and biologist.
 
==Life and career==
Toderas was born in [[Logănești]] on 17 August 1948. He studied biology and [[pedagogy]] at the [[Moldova State University|Chisinau State University]], before earning a doctorate at the Mecinikov [[Odesa University|University of Odessa]], becoming a doctor of biology.{{cn|date=May 2026}}
 
Between 1988 and 2006 he held the position of head of the Department of Zoology and Ecology, Human and Animal Biology at the Faculty of Biology and Pedagogy of the State University of the Republic of Moldova.<ref>{{Cite web |date=5 May 2026 |title=A decedat academicianul Ion Toderaș, unul dintre cei mai importanți biologi din Republica Moldova |url=https://telegraph.md/a-decedat-academicianul-ion-toderas-unul-dintre-cei-mai-importanti-biologi-din-republica-moldova/ |access-date=5 May 2026 |website=Telegraph.md |language=ro-RO}}</ref>
 
He authored 59 patents, five of implementations in the national economy of the Apispir preparation as a biostimulating remedy for the prolificacy and productivity of bee families carried out in collaboration with the National Institute of Microbiology and Biotechnology of the [[Academy of Sciences of Moldova]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=12 June 2023 |title=Acad. Ion Tighineanu: „AȘM a reușit să asocieze Republica Moldova la programele comunitare Cadru” |url=https://moldova1.md/p/11215 |access-date=5 May 2026 |website=moldova1.md |language=en}}</ref>
 
Toderaș died on 4 May 2026, at the age of 77.<ref>{{Cite web |date=5 May 2026 |title=A decedat academicianul Ion Toderaș, unul dintre cei mai importanți biologi din Republica Moldova |url=https://telegraph.md/a-decedat-academicianul-ion-toderas-unul-dintre-cei-mai-importanti-biologi-din-republica-moldova/ |access-date=5 May 2026 |website=Telegraph.md |language=ro-RO}}</ref>
